{"path": "led.py", "content": "from gpiozero import LED
from time import sleep
# LED is wired active-low (anode to 3.3V). Invert the drive so on() pulls LOW.
led = LED(17, active_high=False)
while True:
    led.on()
    sleep(0.5)
    led.off()
    sleep(0.5)
"}

text: Fixed: the LED is wired active-low. A plain active-high driver inverts the intended logic. Use LED(17, active_high=False) so on() drives the pin LOW and the LED lights.
